packages.label: שַׁבָּת וּתְשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה
packages.reason: All nodes in this component share the essential nature of wholeness, rest (נַיְחָא), and completion. שַׁבָּת, שַׁדַּי, and תְּשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה are each expressions of the same state: evil is fully expelled, inner flux ceases, and one dwells in total rest. מֶטַטְרוֹן (מט"ט), מִשְׁנָה, and שֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַחֹל describe the incomplete oscillating state that IS מט"ט before Shabbat arrives — they are the same structural reality as שַׁבָּת/שַׁדַּי viewed from the weekday angle (the container that becomes complete). The node כָּשֵׁר וּפָסוּל טָמֵא וְטָהוֹר אָסוּר וּמֻתָּר names the six-category dual-polarity nature of the incomplete weekday state. The entire chain is a single thematic domain: the axis between incompleteness and completeness, with the teaching directed toward achieving the שַׁבָּת/שַׁדַּי pole. ארץ and נפש (Component B) are merged here because they share the same essential nature of rest-in-completeness: 'שְׁכָן אֶרֶץ – הַיְנוּ בְּחִינוֹת נֶפֶשׁ... הַנֶּפֶשׁ יֵשׁ לוֹ נַיְחָא, מֵחֲמַת שֶׁעָשָׂה תְּשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה... הוּא בְּחִינוֹת שַׁבָּת' — the soul-at-rest is the same essential state as Shabbat-rest.
nodes: כשר ופסול טמא וטהור אסור ומתר

merge_notes.reason: ארץ and נפש form a 2-node component whose shared essential nature is identical to the dominant שבת cluster. The source text (line 22: 'שְׁכָן אֶרֶץ – הַיְנוּ בְּחִינוֹת נֶפֶשׁ... הַנֶּפֶשׁ יֵשׁ לוֹ נַיְחָא מֵחֲמַת שֶׁעָשָׂה תְּשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה... וּכְשֶׁעוֹשֶׂה תְּשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה הוּא בְּחִינוֹת שַׁבָּת') explicitly equates the נֶפֶשׁ-at-rest with the שַׁבָּת state. This is a BECHINA-based merge: ארץ/נפש are expressions of the same wholeness/rest nature (נַיְחָא) as שַׁבָּת/שַׁדַּי/תְּשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה. They are not cause-and-effect links to this cluster but parallel aspects of the same inner reality.
